title: Rate Lock Commitment Relock Fee Amount
content:
The relock fee on a **Rate Lock Commitment** rests on its relock fee points. The relock fee points are the lock's relock fee points, as set for its product, to three decimal places. The relock fee is the relock fee points times the loan amount at lock divided by 100, rounded to the cent.

### Worked examples (hypothetical loan amounts)

| Product | Relock fee points | Loan amount at lock | Relock fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 0.125 | $360,000.00 | 0.125 times $360,000.00 divided by 100, which is $450.00 |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 0.250 | $512,300.00 | 0.250 times $512,300.00 divided by 100, which is $1,280.75 |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 0.250 | $333,333.00 | $833.3325, rounded to the cent, which is $833.33 |
